Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 252 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Rai Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Gyan Babu Pal,Krishna Kumar Chaurasia Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned counsel for the opposite party alongwith learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.
This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.897 of 2017, under sections 403, 420, 467, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali City, District Bijnor, during the pendency of trial.

It is submitted that in this case cheque book of the informant was lost after which a cheque was produced before Corporation Bank for withdrawal of money amounting to Rs.42 lakhs and as this information regarding presentation of cheque was given to the informant, he at his instance,
stopped the payment but the present F.I.R. was lodged against unknown persons in which after investigation final report was submitted by the police three times.

Later on, on the basis of protest made by the informant summoning order was passed by the court concerned on 29.06.2019 which Gaurav Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75318574/
1 was challenged in criminal revision.

entities.text: Gaurav Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was allowed and matter was remanded back to the concerned court by order dated 27.06.2022 and thereafter on 29.11.2022 summoning order was made by the learned court concerned.
Now in pursuance of the process of the court, the applicant is under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record and the fact of the aforesaid case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case during the pendency of trial.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Ashok Gupta  Gaurav Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75318574/

opennyai_summary.decision:
It was allowed and matter was remanded back to the concerned court by order dated 27.06.2022 and thereafter on 29.11.2022 summoning order was made by the learned court concerned.
Now in pursuance of the process of the court, the applicant is under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.
In the event of arrest of the applicant- Gaurav Sharma, shall be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned court everyday when case is fixed unless exempted;
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;
(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by him before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, this order will automatically stand vacated.
